newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand in power pact with Unocal group.
newsitem.headline: Thailand in power pact with Unocal group.

text.p: State-run Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand (EGAT) said on Friday it signed an initial agreement with a Unocal Corp-led consortium to buy power from the group under the Independent Power Producer scheme.

EGAT signed the agreement as a guarantee of purchase so that the group which comprised Unocal Corp, semi-government Thai Oil and Westinghouse could use the document to raise funds to finance the consortium's gas-fired power plant project.

EGAT intends to buy power from the consortium's 700-megawatt plant in Chonburi near Bangkok at 1.25 baht (U$$0.05) per kilowatt/hour for 25 years, once the group starts generating power to an EGAT grid.
The agency plans to buy 4,200 megawatts of power from independent producers by 2002 to keep pace with growing demand.
The Unocal consortium was one of the 13 groups shortlisted by the EGAT as potential power suppliers.
